newsitem.title: UK: Charter slips after results disappoint.
newsitem.headline: Charter slips after results disappoint.

text.p: Shares in industrial group Charter Plc slipped in early trading on Tuesday after the company issued a cautious trading statement and said its second half results were running short of earlier expectations.
The rail track equipment, building materials and welding products group reported a 4.6 percent rise in first half pre-tax profits to 51.9 million stg on slightly lower sales of 570.3 million stg.
But it said the results failed to meet expectations and it expected the trading environment to remain challenging.
"It's the weakness in their European markets. They're still finding it tough there, but I think it's a bit overdone and the shares should bounce," said one trader.
The company said performance in the second half of the year would depend on the pace of recovery in European economies.
